title: Decomposition
description: The specifier's PHASE-1 output: the maximal decomposition of one task into atomic, haiku-implementable behaviors. Emitted without halting, then carried into the single consolidated PLAN gate where the human reviews it alongside the pruned Gherkin and prune_log.

behaviors.description: the exhaustive set of atomic, independently-observable behaviors; carried forward verbatim into gherkin.json and presented together with it at the PLAN gate

min_tier.description: cheapest model that can implement this leaf in one pass; STOPPING RULE targets 'trivial' (haiku); 'standard'/'complex' => decompose one more level

depth.description: decomposition level this leaf sits at; target 3-5

criterion_ids.description: acceptance_criteria this behavior traces to; empty => ask (hardener under-specified)

stopping_rule.description: evidence the STOPPING RULE was applied; all_trivial=false means some leaf is not yet haiku-implementable and must be split further before the plan gate can approve

non_trivial_leaves.description: behavior ids still at standard/complex; must be empty to pass
